title: Complement duality for alternating classes
statement: For every Boolean quantifier type $b$, every $i\in\mathbb{N}$, and every binary language $L$, the complement of $L$ belongs to the alternating class with quantifier type $b$ and $i$ quantifier steps if and only if $L$ belongs to the corresponding class with the opposite quantifier type: $L^{c}\in\mathrm{AltClass}(b,i)$ if and only if $L\in\mathrm{AltClass}(\neg b,i)$.
